public_contract: The coupon input is quoted as 5 percent. The cash coupon must equal notional multiplied by the decimal coupon rate. The public notional is 100.
runtime_evidence: artifact parses the quoted coupon token as the floating value 5.0

normalize-rate-and-replay.description: Normalize the public percent quote to decimal form while leaving the multiplication formula unchanged, then replay coupon_cash.
normalize-rate-and-replay.observation: With coupon_rate normalized from 5.0 to 0.05, the unchanged formula produces coupon_cash 5.0, exactly satisfying the public relation.

double-notional.description: Double notional while leaving the parsed rate and formula unchanged, then replay coupon_cash.
double-notional.observation: Doubling notional doubles coupon_cash from 500 to 1000; this does not separate quote scale from the multiplication formula.

public_contract: Net P&L must reconcile as gross P&L minus transaction cost. Transaction cost equals turnover times the public cost rate. The holdings path and prices are held fixed for a cost-only replay.
runtime_evidence: artifact reports gross P&L 12 and net P&L 12
replayed turnover is 4 and public cost rate is 0.25
the execution trace contains both prior and current holdings arrays

cost-only-replay.description: Double only the public cost rate while holding prices and both holdings arrays fixed, then replay reported net P&L.
cost-only-replay.observation: The expected cost changes from 1 to 2, but artifact net P&L remains 12 in both replays; the cost term is absent from reported net P&L.

shift-holdings-one-period.description: Shift holdings by one period while leaving the cost rate fixed, then replay gross and net P&L.
shift-holdings-one-period.observation: Both gross and net P&L change together and remain equal; this does not explain why the public cost term is missing from their bridge.

public_contract: The final report must state net P&L. The retained summary does not include holdings, turnover, trade timestamps, or a gross-to-net bridge.
runtime_evidence: retained report contains only final net P&L 8.1
the Worker trace ended before persisting intermediate portfolio state
no replayable holdings or transaction-cost series is available

inspect-retained-summary.description: Inspect the retained report and trace again for holdings, turnover, timestamps, or cost fields.
inspect-retained-summary.observation: No additional holdings, turnover, timestamps, cost fields, or replayable state are present. Missing cost and timing mismatch remain observationally equivalent.

compare-final-scalar.description: Compare the reported final scalar with the same retained scalar.
compare-final-scalar.observation: The two copies of the final scalar agree, but this supplies no evidence about cost treatment or holdings timing.
